def g78_collect_rows_acc():
    import math
    execution=json.loads(read(str(g78_execution_path_acc)))
    assert execution['status']=='ALL_CELLS_FINISHED' and len(execution['cells'])==8 and all(c['passed'] for c in execution['cells'])
    assert [c['id'] for c in execution['cells']]==[c['id'] for c in g78_cells_acc]
    rows=[]
    for cell,actual in zip(g78_cells_acc,execution['cells']):
        req=json.loads(read(cell['request']['path']));r=json.loads(read(cell['report']));p=json.loads(read(cell['report']+'.physical.json'))
        assert r['status']=='PASS' and r['mode']=='js' and r['stopAfter']=='check' and r['checksExcluded']==r['outputPatches']==0 and r['acceptanceEvidence']is False
        assert r['requestSha256']==cell['request']['sha256']==g56_ref_acc(cell['request']['path'])['sha256']
        assert r['moduleCount']==17 and r['sourceDeclarations']==2954 and r['stepCounts']=={'expand':263032,'check':1975761}
        assert r['exports']==req['exports']==g78_protocol_acc['runtime']['ABIExports'] and r['limits']==g78_protocol_acc['limits'] and r['workerPolicy']==g78_protocol_acc['runtime']['workerPolicy']
        assert r['runtime']['versions']['node']=='23.11.0' and r['runtime']['versions']['v8']=='12.9.202.28-node.14' and r['runtime']['execArgv']==g78_protocol_acc['runtime']['execArgv']
        assert Path(r['runtime']['execPath']).resolve()==Path(g43_tools_acc['node']).resolve() and r['source']==req['root'] and r['sourceSha256']==g56_ref_acc(req['root'])['sha256']
        assert [x['phase'] for x in r['phases']]==['startup','load-parse','expand','check'] and len(req['inputs'])==52
        assert all(g56_ref_acc(path)['sha256']==h for path,h in req['inputs'].items())
        assert all(g56_ref_acc(path)['sha256']==h for path,h in req['pins'].items() if path!=str(g78_slot_path_acc))
        activation=actual['activation'];assert activation['postPinsVerified']is True and activation['active']['sha256']==activation['post']['sha256']==cell['source']['sha256']==req['pins'][str(g78_slot_path_acc)]
        assert req['image']==g78_protocol_acc['image']['path'] and req['pins'][req['image']]==g78_protocol_acc['image']['sha256']
        assert p['status']=='PASS' and p['exit']['code']==0 and p['targetPid']==p['ready']['targetPid'] and p['targetStartMicros']==p['ready']['targetStartMicros'] and p['count']==len(p['samples']) and 2<=p['count']<=4096 and not p['overflow'] and p['readErrors']==0 and p['intervalMs']==200
        assert p['columns']==g77_protocol_acc['physicalSamplerContract']['sampleColumns'] and p['samples'][0][1]-p['clockBridge']['rawOffsetMs']<=r['phases'][0]['startMs'] and p['samples'][-1][1]-p['clockBridge']['rawOffsetMs']>=r['phases'][-1]['endMs']
        guard=actual['guardian'];assert guard['status']=='PASS' and guard['ownedTreeStopped'] and guard['timeoutMs']==600000 and guard['memoryLimitBytes']==guard['rssLimitBytes']==8589934592
        check=r['phases'][-1];v=r['verification'];row={k:cell[k] for k in ['id','sequence','block','variant']};row.update({'request':cell['request'],'report':g56_ref_acc(cell['report']),'physical':g56_ref_acc(cell['report']+'.physical.json'),'checkerCpuMs':check['userCpuMs']+check['systemCpuMs'],'checkerWallMs':check['elapsedMs'],'footprintBytes':guard['peakFootprintBytes'],'rssBytes':guard['peakRssBytes'],'guardElapsedMs':guard['elapsedMs'],'verificationWallMs':v['elapsedMs'],'verificationCpuMs':v['userCpuMs']+v['systemCpuMs'],'activation':activation})
        assert all(math.isfinite(row[k])and row[k]>0 for k in ['checkerCpuMs','checkerWallMs','footprintBytes','rssBytes','guardElapsedMs','verificationWallMs','verificationCpuMs'])
        rows.append(row)
    return rows
